name: Prepatellar Bursitis
definition: Inflammation or swelling of the prepatellar bursa from repetitive kneeling, trauma, crystal disease or infection.

investigations.principle: Usually clinical; aspiration is considered if infection/crystals are suspected.
investigations.radiographs: Radiographs if trauma/bone disease is suspected.

amber: Suspected septic bursitis requires aspiration/culture and antibiotics.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Janu-shotha phenotype may be documented after infection is excluded.

patientEducation.summary: Inflammation or swelling of the prepatellar bursa from repetitive kneeling, trauma, crystal disease or infection.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
